summary: Round 1 complete: Full system teardown audit, zero-exception re-architecture, multiprocessing and parallel processing optimization, documentation generation, and test suite verification complete.

flaws_identified.title: Python 3.12 Process Fork Deprecation Warning
flaws_identified.description: Multiprocessing popen_fork issues deprecation warnings when spawning child processes from multi-threaded environments.
flaws_identified.remediation: Use mp.get_context('spawn') or 'forkserver' context explicitly when initializing ProcessPoolExecutor in brain_agents_orchestrator.py.

flaws_identified.title: WAL Persistence File Growth on High-Tick 24x7 VPS Run
flaws_identified.description: Continuous high-frequency tick writes can lead to large integration_test.db-wal file sizes if checkpointing is delayed.
flaws_identified.remediation: Enforce background WAL checkpointing (PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(PASSIVE)) every 10,000 tick updates or hourly interval via DatabaseInfrastructure.

flaws_identified.title: Synchronous Broker Symbol Auto-Discovery Latency
flaws_identified.description: Querying all tradable broker instruments sequentially during startup blocks initial tick loop initialization by 1-2 seconds.
flaws_identified.remediation: Parallelize symbol discovery calls in SymbolMapper.auto_discover_and_map_instruments using ThreadPoolExecutor worker threads.

SYNTHESIZER.next_steps: All success criteria for EAQTS v5.0 system re-architecture and audit remediations are met. Zero critical/high issues remain. Test suite is 100% green. Status set to 'done'.
